beats.canonical: Harlow's delayed voicemail lights the recorder.
Pike reaches for the door. The forensic tape holds him here.

suspects.actingNotes: Warm, quick, defensive only about money.
suspects.name: Imran Qadir
suspects.persona: A charming debtor whose jokes stop when someone mentions his father's shop.
suspects.secret: Stole his signed debt note from Harlow's Hall coat pocket to protect his father's shop.

suspects.actingNotes: Controlled, precise; let the politeness sharpen under pressure.
suspects.name: Marguerite Vale
suspects.persona: An immaculate trustee who treats every question as a breach of etiquette.
suspects.secret: Forged the Harlow charitable trust accounts; Edmund planned to give the originals to the police.

suspects.actingNotes: Measured and dry; grief surfaces only in brief pauses.
suspects.name: Dr. Ada Okafor
suspects.persona: A physician protecting her sister's dignity, impatient with theatrical accusations.
suspects.secret: Borrowed medicine without logging it to treat her uninsured sister; Harlow threatened to report her.

suspects.actingNotes: Clipped, polished, with a nervous rush at the ends of sentences.
suspects.name: Jonah Pike
suspects.persona: A brittle art dealer rehearsing sophistication while looking for the nearest exit.
suspects.secret: Forged the provenance of a miniature he sold to Harlow; came to switch the certificate.
